title: Lattice enthalpy and ion size
caption: Lattice enthalpy becomes less exothermic from NaF to NaI: the halide ions get larger, so the oppositely charged ions are further apart and attract less. Charge matters even more: MgO, with 2+ and 2− ions, is −3791 kJ mol⁻¹.
alt: Bar chart of lattice enthalpies: NaF −923, NaCl −787, NaBr −747, NaI −704 kJ/mol.
description: NaI −704: the largest anion, the least exothermic.
yLabel: lattice enthalpy of formation / kJ mol⁻¹
